items.title: JJ Johnson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: That quintet was born, the one [that] involved Rufus Reid, Victor Lewis on drums and Cedar Walton, of course, on piano.

ctx.x: You picked the tunes very carefully.

And the personnel. It didn’t hurt to have that strong supporting cast of Rufus Reid and his trio. Actually it was his trio – Rob Schneiderman and Akira Tana – with the addition of the brilliant guitarist . . .
